rankDescriptions.APPRENTICE: Just starting your engineering journey. First tools in hand.
rankDescriptions.NOVICE: You master basic techniques. First models successfully built.
rankDescriptions.TECHNICIAN: You understand technical drawings and specifications. Building is a breeze.
rankDescriptions.ENGINEER: Officially an engineer! You can solve complex projects independently.
rankDescriptions.SPECIALIST: Expert in specialized areas. Your work is precise.
rankDescriptions.ARCHITECT: You design custom modifications and improvements. Creativity + technique.
rankDescriptions.MASTER: Master of your craft. Your models are works of art.
rankDescriptions.INNOVATOR: You invent new technologies and approaches. Pushing the limits.
rankDescriptions.LEGEND: Legendary engineer. Your name is synonymous with perfection.

cassandra.title: 🔧 Cassandra - Your Engineering Mascot
cassandra.subtitle: Cassandra's outfit changes as you progress through engineering skills!
cassandra.earnXpDescription: 💡 Earn XP by purchasing products, completing builds, unlocking achievements, and referring friends. Cassandra will automatically get a new outfit when you reach the next rank!
